main_text.p: ADministra χυλώσεως membra iunt[?], quæ confectioni & elaboratio-ni chyli ministerium exhibent.
Suntq; organa vel ingestionis, vel e-gestionis.
Organa ingestionisOrgana ingestionis sunt, quæ cibum in ventriculos superiùs ingerunt.
Suntq; rursus alia masticationis, alia deglutionis.
Ingeritur autem cibus ad masticationem per Os, cui subserviunt musculi Maxillares, quorum alii os referant, alii obserant.
Masticatio quomodo fiatMasticatio fit dentibus, aliis incidens-tibus, & frangentibus, aliis conterenti-bus & levigantibus.
1. Masticationi subserviunt: Gingiva, scilicet caro dentes circumvallans, eorumque calorem fovens, imò in senibus edentulis qualescunq; dentium vices su-stinens.
2. Secundò, Musculus quartus maxillaris, qui circumagendo maxillam inferiorem, masticationem promovet.
3. Tertiò, Lingua masticationis opus quasi regit, dapes, dum in ore moluntur, ele-vans & deorsum tendentes sustinens.

page.notes: The woodcut initial A is joined to "Dministra" as "ADministra". Greek "χυλώσεως" copied as printed, no accent visible. Word "iunt" at line end of the first paragraph is doubtful (printed form may be "sunt"); marked [?]. Numbered paragraphs 1., 2., 3. are the printed "1.", "Secundò", "Tertiò" openings; the printed "1." and the italic openings are kept as written. The signature at the bottom left is too faint to read reliably and is omitted. Show-through from the reverse side on the right margin and faint marks at top left are not transcribed.
